an5.74:1.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
an5.74:1.3: Kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu dhammavihārī hotī ti? 2.
an5.74:2.2: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ,
an5.74:2.3: uttariñ c'assa paññāya atthaṃ na ppajānāti.
an5.74:2.4: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu bhikkhu pariyattibahulo, no dhammavihārī. 3.
an5.74:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhu bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena paresaṃ deseti, uttariñ c'assa paññāya atthaṃ na ppajānāti.
an5.74:3.2: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu bhikkhu paññattibahulo, no dhammavihārī. 4.
an5.74:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhu bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karoti, uttariñ c'assa paññāya atthaṃ na ppajānāti.
an5.74:4.2: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu bhikkhu sajjhāyabahulo, no dhammavihāri. 5.
an5.74:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhu bhikkhu yathāsutaṃ yathapariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasānupekkhati, uttariñ c'assa paññāya atthaṃ na ppajānāti.
an5.74:5.2: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu bhikkhu vitakkabahulo, no dhammavihārī. 6.
an5.74:6.2: suttam geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthaṃ udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ,
an5.74:6.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhu bhikkhu dhammavihārī hoti. 7.
an5.74:7.1: Iti kho bhikkhu bhikkhu desito mayā pariyattibahulo, desito paññattibahulo, desito sajjhāyabahulo, desito vitakkabahulo, desito dhammavihārī.
an5.74:7.2: Yaṃ bhikkhu Satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya, kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
an5.74:7.3: Etāni bhikkhu rukkhamūlāni, etāni suññāgārāni. Jhāyatha bhikkhu mā pamādattha, mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. Ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanī
